title: Ptolemaic temple inscriptions of Edfu, Chassinat Edfou I–V / Надписи храма Гора в Эдфу
author: Priests of the Edfu temple
genre: Ritual, theological and geographical temple texts
size: Chassinat, 14 volumes in all; Edfou I–V several thousand text columns (estimate)
edition: Chassinat, Le temple d'Edfou (IFAO, 1892–1934; likely public domain); German translations by Kurth (Edfou VIII 1998, VII 2004, VI 2014).
ru_evidence: CyberLeninka 'Эдфу надпись перевод' finds no translations; none found.
en_evidence: Only selected texts in English; Kurth's 2004 English guide (de.wikipedia 'Edfu-Projekt').
other_translations: German: Edfou VI–VIII complete (Edfu-Projekt); Edfou I–V largely untranslated in any language.
value: The largest coherent body of Ptolemaic theology, ritual and sacred geography, and the self-image of priests under Greek kings. Core volumes have no translation in any language.
ai_feasibility: low: Ptolemaic sign values and no open transliteration; the source is image-based. Needs an Egyptologist in the loop; a long-term project.
pilot_unit: Ritual scenes of one chapel in Edfou I (est. 30–50 pp.)
